title: Dinner for four
explanation: The options were not really different, and the pick gave a reason that the comparison did not support. When you ask for options and a pick, check that the options differ and that the reason matches your criteria.
setup: Give me three different dinner ideas for four people, compared on cost and time, then recommend one.

sentences.text: 1. Lentil soup with bread: cost low, time 40 minutes.
2. Chicken and vegetable stir-fry: cost medium, time 25 minutes.
3. Lentil soup with rice: cost low, time 45 minutes.
sentences.note: This is almost the same idea as option 1. The order asked for three different ideas.

sentences.text: I recommend the stir-fry because it is the cheapest.
sentences.note: Option 1 is cheaper. The reason does not match the comparison above it.

sentences.text: It also takes the least time.
